clue.text: Bottom, an ass? He's put these on before going off, perhaps

definitions.text: put these on before going off, perhaps

parts.note: a bed is the bottom of a river or sea
a clot is a fool, an ass
taken as written, without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: Bottom, Shakespeare's weaver turned into an ass, seems to be pulling something on before going off.
explanation.walkthrough: Bottom recalls the Midsummer Night's Dream character, but here it is just the bed of a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheets and blankets are what a sleeper draws over themselves before dropping off to sleep.

clue.text: Hair stood on edge during tough sale? Yes

indicators.note: in a down clue, standing the letters up on end means reading them from the bottom upwards
during signals letters lying within the run of words tough sale? Yes

explanation.surface: Someone's hair stood on end during a hard-fought sale, and the answer to the question is yes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'during' picks HSALEYE out of 'tougH SALE YEs', and 'stood on edge' turns it upwards in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A lash is a single short hair growing from the rim of the eyelid.

clue.text: Army chief posts piece of cake

parts.note: C-in-C is short for Commander-in-Chief
rugby goalposts are shaped like the letter H

explanation.surface: A general puts up a slice of cake, perhaps on social media.
explanation.walkthrough: Rugby posts form an H, the convention used here.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are informal idioms for a task that is very easy to do.

clue.text: Occasionally switch positions

definitions.meaning: the two settings of a light switch

explanation.surface: Every so often, swap places.
explanation.definitionFit: Intermittently is the idiom's sense; a switch literally has these two positions.

clue.text: Novella in which king and knight briefly appear

definitions.meaning: a short novel, here Joseph Conrad's tale of the Congo

definitions.text: in which king and knight briefly appear
definitions.meaning: K and N are chess shorthand for king and knight, and they sit at the very centre of the title's last word

explanation.surface: A short novel that features a king and a knight in passing.
explanation.walkthrough: The second half reads the title literally: the middle of DARKNESS is KN, chess shorthand for king and knight.
explanation.definitionFit: Joseph Conrad's tale of a voyage up the Congo is a famous short work, longer than a story but shorter than a full novel.

clue.text: Wherein JD Salinger essentially goes off message

indicators.note: going off, like a bomb, scatters the remaining letters into a new order
only the essential part of the surname is kept, its final pair of letters dropped

explanation.surface: A puzzle about a passage in which the reclusive author JD Salinger strays from his message.
explanation.walkthrough: 'essentially' trims SALINGER to SALING, and 'goes off' rearranges those six letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A signal is a sign or communication sent to convey information, so it serves as a message.

clue.text: Where kippers might be the choice of many?

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a lot
or is the word that offers a choice
M is the Roman numeral for 1000, also a lot

explanation.surface: Smoked herrings might be a popular pick.
explanation.walkthrough: A kipper is British slang for a sleeper (a kip is a nap), not just a smoked herring.
explanation.definitionFit: A dormitory is a shared bedroom where sleepers bed down.

clue.text: Uses ducking stool, perhaps, once light's dimmer

definitions.meaning: in the old days a suspected witch was dunked in water on a ducking stool, which dips the witch
a car's switch that lowers the headlight beam

explanation.surface: An old punishment set against a device for turning lights down.
explanation.definitionFit: On a car the dip switch lowers the headlamp beam so oncoming drivers are not dazzled.

clue.text: Managed firm, supported by your texted venom

indicators.note: in a down entry, being supported means having this piece placed beneath

parts.note: ran a business means managed it
Co is short for company, a firm
UR is text-message shorthand for your

explanation.surface: A boss's company is backed by poisonous messages from you.
explanation.definitionFit: Venom figuratively means bitter spite, the same as deep-seated resentment.

clue.text: Film director found in list

definitions.meaning: a ship that lists tilts to one side

explanation.surface: A filmmaker's name turns up in a register.
explanation.definitionFit: David Lean is the director, and to tilt or tip is the verb's sense matching list.

clue.text: Perfume female called Isis originally, after one Greek deity

indicators.note: after places the first letter of Isis behind the piece before it

parts.note: rang means telephoned, called
I is the Roman numeral one
Pan is the Greek god of the wild

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letter of the goddess's name

explanation.surface: A woman phoned Isis, then a Greek god, about scent.
explanation.definitionFit: The scent of the tropical frangipani flower is used to make a fragrance of the same name.

clue.text: Long to be in a northern spa town

indicators.note: to be in signals one piece sitting inside the other

parts.note: to ache for something is to long for it

explanation.surface: Wishing to be in a spa resort in the north.
explanation.definitionFit: The German city near the Belgian border is famed for its hot springs, hence a spa town.

clue.text: It's very tough to beat tae kwon do champion's last outing

indicators.note: beat means stir or whisk, so the letters are mixed up
outing means putting out, so this letter is dropped
last picks the final letter of the word champion

explanation.surface: A martial-arts champion is hard to beat at his final bout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outing' drops N from TAEKWONDO, and 'to beat' stirs TAEKWODO into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Teak is a famously hard, durable timber used for ships and furniture.

clue.text: Give a tick to playwright's broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means spoken on air, so the playwright's name is heard

parts.note: Anton Chekhov is the Russian playwright who wrote The Seagull

explanation.surface: Approving a radio production of a dramatist's work.
explanation.definitionFit: To tick an item on a list is to mark it as done or verified.

clue.text: Man overboard? Hoist way up!

parts.note: to chair is to man, or preside over, a board meeting
a lift is a hoist

explanation.surface: Someone falls off a ship and the crew cries to haul them up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man overboard' is not an emergency: it is presiding over a board.
explanation.definitionFit: A ski resort's cable seats carry skiers up the mountain, so it is a means of going up.

clue.text: One sailing before noon in lake

parts.note: a tar is a sailor

explanation.surface: A sailor out on the water before midday.
explanation.definitionFit: A tarn is a small mountain lake, the word common in the English Lake District.

clue.text: Six runs, so hit sightscreen?

indicators.note: hit means struck about, so the letters are knocked into a new order

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A cricket batsman hits a six towards the sightscreen.
explanation.walkthrough: A sightscreen is the white board behind the bowler that helps the batter see the ball in cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: A visor shields the eyes from glare, so it is a screen that helps sight, a playful extension.

clue.text: Parrot has answer on tip of beak repeatedly

indicators.note: repeatedly means the pair is written out twice
on means placed after, in an across clue
the tip of the beak is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A parrot keeps hitting the end of its beak with something.
explanation.definitionFit: The kaka is a large New Zealand parrot.

clue.text: Go ahead with early March offer

definitions.meaning: to march on is to move forward

explanation.surface: Proceed with an offer in early March.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means to proceed, march forward, prior as in booking, and a proposal or approach.

clue.text: A short practice involving little growth in capital

indicators.note: involving means taking in the next piece
short means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: a habit is a regular practice
a bud is the small first growth of a plant

explanation.surface: A brief training session for a little plant.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the capital city of the United Arab Emirates.

clue.text: Blessing well in African country

indicators.note: in places one word inside the country's name

parts.note: Benin is a West African republic
so is a filler like well at the start of a sentence

explanation.surface: A water well blessed in an African land.
explanation.definitionFit: A benison is an old literary word for a benediction.

clue.text: Italian city getting up-to-date, but not right away

indicators.note: not signals taking a letter out

parts.note: modern means up-to-date
A is short for away, as in sports fixtures

explanation.surface: An Italian city being modernised, but slowly.
explanation.definitionFit: The city in Emilia-Romagna is home to Ferrari and balsamic vinegar.

clue.text: What some airlines do with surplus volume

parts.note: over means left over, surplus
a book is a volume

explanation.surface: Airlines dealing with an excess of something.
explanation.definitionFit: Carriers sell more seats than a flight holds, expecting no-shows.

clue.text: Given to dithering after dropping a tablet, making one cross?

indicators.note: dithering is wavering, so the letters are unsettled into a new order
after dropping signals a letter taken out first

parts.note: E is slang for an ecstasy tablet

explanation.surface: Someone prone to hesitation stops taking a pill and gets irritable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after dropping' takes E out of GIVENTO, and 'dithering' reshuffles GIVNTO.
explanation.definitionFit: A ballot is marked with an X, so casting a vote means putting a cross on the paper.

clue.text: Umpteenth rumba's to repeat monotonously

indicators.note: the 's stands for has: the phrase has the answer within its letters

explanation.surface: Dancing the rumba for the umpteenth time becomes a dull repetition.
explanation.definitionFit: To strum or drone the same thing over and over, like a steady hum.

clue.text: Difference in US kennel is staggering

indicators.note: staggering means reeling about, so the letters are shaken up

explanation.surface: An American dog kennel's divergence is astonishing.
explanation.definitionFit: A lack of similarity is what separates two things, the same as dissimilarity.

clue.text: Right wood for hives?

parts.note: ash is a tree and its timber

explanation.surface: Choosing the correct timber for beehives.
explanation.walkthrough: Hives here is the skin complaint, not homes for bees.
explanation.definitionFit: Hives (urticaria) is an itchy outbreak on the skin, an eruption of spots.

clue.text: Send message that's offensive, without a kiss

indicators.note: without means outside, wrapped around the kiss

parts.note: the Tet offensive was a 1968 campaign in the Vietnam War
X is a kiss at the end of a letter

explanation.surface: Sending a rude message with no affectionate sign-off.
explanation.definitionFit: To send a phone message is the verb's everyday sense.

clue.text: When ugly monster initially terrified mixed group

parts.note: as means when, as in as I left

indicators.note: ugly signals the letters are disfigured into a new arrangement
initially means the opening letter

explanation.surface: People were frightened when a hideous monster appeared.
explanation.definitionFit: A miscellany or mixture is a collection of varied things.
